title: Jujutsu Kaisen (Sorcery Fight)
description: Jujutsu Kaisen is a Modpack based on the Anime/Manga "Sorcery Fight" by Gege Akutami.
body:
![Jujutsu Kaisen Header](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Jujutsu_Kaisen_Sorcery_Fight/BH_Jujutsu_Kaisen_Sorcery_Fight_header.webp)
[![Jujutsu Kaisen Bisecthosting](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Jujutsu_Kaisen_Sorcery_Fight/BH_Jujutsu_Kaisen_Sorcery_Fight_promo2.webp)](https://tinyurl.com/amy67484)
![Jujutsu Kaisen Banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Jujutsu_Kaisen_Sorcery_Fight/BH_Jujutsu_Kaisen_Sorcery_Fight_overview.webp)
---
**Jujutsu Kaisen (Sorcery Fight)** is a gameplay focused modpack based on Jujutsu Kaisen. Enjoy a world filled with a variety of sorcerers, monsters, curses and more, play as your favourite people from Jujutsu Kaisen or go down the demonic path. This modpack is designed to balance both gameplay and performance while preserving the theme of Jujutsu Kaisen, enjoy a host of other mods that will compliment your travels.

---
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/3SauFGHWgOg?si=rqEWhIel1iuhzDoE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![Jujutsu Kaisen Features](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Jujutsu_Kaisen_Sorcery_Fight/BH_Jujutsu_Kaisen_Sorcery_Fight_features.webp)
---
- [⚔️] **JujutsuCraft** - Sorcerers, monsters and curses all want to kill you, don't make the mistake of thinking there all friendly.
- [🧭] **Explore** - This world holds a lot of mystery, run down structures and cities filled with curses and cursed objects.
- [🪦] **Grave** - Planning on dying, don't worry we've got you covered, when you drop so does your body keeping your loot safe.
- [🏃] **ParCool** - Enjoy a variety of fresh animations, diving off a cliff? Do it in style, or perhaps you need to crawl somewhere.

---
